import random,time,resource
from syntax import parse_policy
from ebpf.create_dfa import create,PolicyError
random.seed(44)
names=[chr(65+i) for i in range(16)];reg=[{'name':n,'label':i+1} for i,n in enumerate(names)]
S=set()
while len(S)<4096:S.add(tuple(random.randrange(16) for _ in range(16)))
paths=[','.join(names[i] for i in t) for t in S]
text=''.join('match('+p+') allow;' for p in paths)
print('bytes',len(text),'pathsyms',sum(16 for _ in paths),flush=True)
t=time.time();p=parse_policy(text);print('parse',time.time()-t,flush=True)
t=time.time()
try:
 im=create(text,reg,p);print('compile',time.time()-t,'rows',len(im['rows']),flush=True)
except Exception as e:print('reject',type(e).__name__,e,'time',time.time()-t,flush=True)
print('rss',resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss)
